compat-empty.json.why: compat is a non-empty lower-case token

delta-with-delta-family.json.why: a delta quantity has no deltaFamily of its own

dimension-reserved-unknown.json.why: -128 is reserved for the unknown dimension (D-085)

duplicate-alias.json.why: aliases of one unit are unique

empty-units.json.why: a quantity has at least its base unit

ids-not-symbols.json.why: files store symbols, never registry ids

missing-base.json.why: every quantity names its base unit

scalar-and-tobase.json.why: scalar and toBase state the same factor; give one

scalar-zero.json.why: a scalar of 0 has no inverse

symbol-non-ascii.json.why: symbols are ASCII; the Unicode form goes in display

symbol-padded.json.why: symbols have no leading or trailing space

tobase-zero.json.why: a unit of size 0 has no inverse

unit-unknown-member.json.why: unit records are closed (factor is not a member)
